scope: Local same-engine 320x480 RGB565 + factory font. No device access.
findings: Former >=600 weights used full 1px horizontal bitmap dilation; >=24px also full vertical dilation. Small Chinese strokes became visually coarse.
Rounded cards, buttons and icons formerly used binary corner masks.
RGB565 ordered-dither gradients produced visible grain on the home backgrounds.
changes: Cached 20/64px semibold and 32/64px bold outline weights; regular native pixel size preserved.
4x4 fixed spatial coverage only near rounded edges, opaque interior fast path; no full-frame supersampling.
Solid home surfaces and thinner antialiased two-series chart lines.
Single-frame aggregate quota, three SIMs, cable status and thermal values; CA summary on second page and scrollable carrier/Ethernet details.
CA explicitly labelled primary-card radio carrier aggregation, independent from aggregation-network service.
timingCaveat: Three repeats x 50 frames; desktop only, not device FPS. Initial 0.1.7 home repaint ~2.69ms; current ~1.77ms. Detail repaint ~1.13ms vs ~1.07ms baseline.
